blogs.title: Mashed Apple Sauce Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए मसला हुआ सेब सॉस पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
If you are planning to start your baby with solid food, I recommend you to start with apples. Because apples are non-allergenic fruits and there are packed with tons of nutrients which is a perfect fruit to include in your baby's diet. So my first baby food recipe is going to be apple puree, also known as apple sauce.

 

How to do apple puree:

 

1) Take a nice, firm, sweet, juicy apple. Cut a small piece of apple from it and place it inside a bowl. 

2) Take a pressure cooker and fill the bottom with some water. Now place that bowl inside a pressure cooker. 

3) Cover the cooker and cook it for 8 to 10 whistles. Switch off the heat and let the steam escape all by itself. 

4) Open the cooker and remove the bowl carefully. If there is any water inside the bowl, drain that. Allow the apple to cool a bit so you can handle it.

5) Now peel the skin of the apple, since the apple is cooked, the skin just peels off.

6) Now You have two options to make apple puree. you could either mash the apple well with a spoon, add a splash of water if you wish. Keep mashing till the apple is completely mashed up. This type of mashing the apple with a spoon gives a little chunky apple puree and gives the puree some texture or If you want a smooth puree, put the cooked apples in a mixer and puree it. This will give you a smooth puree.

 

Now pour the prepared apple sauce in the sterilized bowl, the easy part is done. Now it is your talent to feed this to your fussy baby.

blogs.title: Homemade Ragi Porridge ( Finger Millet ) Recipes for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए घर का बना रागी दलिया (फिंगर बाजरा) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
For a few days, I was making ragi porridge using fresh ragi. Then I came across making homemade ragi powder recipe at home and immediately gave it a shot. And many of you asked for that recipe, so here it is.

 

Ragi is very healthy for babies, it is filling and help your baby gain weight in a healthy way. Few things you have to remember before making this.

 

1)The consistency of the porridge which you make totally depends on you. You can make it too runnier and pour it bottles and feed your baby or make it a little thicker and feed your baby using a spoon.

2) I use panakarkandu or karupatti as a sweetener. This is how I do. I take a small piece of karupatti or a piece of panakarkandu in a saucepan, add some water in it and heat it up till it is melted. Then I strain that and add ragi powder in it, strain again and cook them together.  Karupatti strengthens your baby bones. Panakarkandu helps to prevent cold for your babies. You can even mix up a small piece of both.

3) If you feed a good bowl of this for your baby. Your baby will sleep peacefully for a good 2 to 3 hours. It is that filling.

4) Cook ragi properly. If you didn’t cook it properly, it may cause constipation.  

5) Many people say ragi may cause constipation. But I am feeding them to my baby for 3 weeks now. And she is passing stool daily.  

 

How to make Ragi Porridge using Homemade Powder:

 

Take a clean saucepan, add in 2 tablespoon of karupatti. Now pour in 3/4 cup of clean water. Heat this up and cook until the karupatti is melted.

Now take a clean bowl and a fine-mesh strainer. Sieve the liquid through this.

Now add a tablespoon of homemade ragi powder in the liquid and mix well so no lumps are formed.

I washed the saucepan and sieve well in the meantime. Now pour this liquid again through the sieve in the saucepan.

Heat this on a low flame stirring continuously. Cook this for around 4 to 5 mins till the ragi is cooked and thicken.

Take it off the heat, allow it to cool down and transfer it to a feeding bowl or feeding bottle and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Carrot Puree Recipe for Toddlers and Kids
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए गाजर प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Carrots form the best first food for babies. Carrots are rich in Beta Carotene and have tons of Vitamins. Since the veggie is sweet, babies love it so much. 

 

Things to remember:

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth. 

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion & experience carrots won't cause any constipation in babies.

4) I don't prefer freezing carrot purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge.

5) When choosing carrot, get bright colored firm ones.

6) Carrots are less likely to have any allergenic reactions.

 

How to make Carrot Puree:

 

Take a firm and sweet carrot. Wash it well in water. You can start with a small to medium size carrot. Cut them finely and add them to a clean bowl.

Now place this in a steamer or do what I do. I heat a pan with water and place a small separator at the bottom of the pan. Then keep the bowl over the separator(which comes with your pressure cooker) and cover the pan and steam for a good 10 to 12 mins till the carrot is cooked.

While the carrots are cooking, you can make the sweetener. You could add some sugar to your baby. But I prefer adding some panakarkandu. I take some panakarkandu and cover it with some water. Heat it so the karkandu dissolves. Now strain this and transfer it to a clean airtight container. You can store this in the fridge and use it whenever you need it. I make this and keep it for 2 to 3 days in the fridge.

When the carrots are done, transfer the carrots to a blender. Add some of the panakarkandu juice and puree them till smooth.

Now pour this into a sterilized bowl and feed your baby. You can pour this into a feeding bottle and feed your baby. I cut a bigger hole in my feeding bottle nipple and feed my baby, this way it is easy and convenient.

blogs.title: Homemade Apple, Oats and Cinnamon ( Cereal ) Porridge Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए घर का बना सेब, ओट्स और दालचीनी (अनाज) दलिया रेसिपी
blogs.content:
I have heard that oats are really a portion of good food to introduce your baby when is has crossed her 6 months. Oats are a very healthy grain and make a portion of great first food for your babies.  A few days back, I decided to make oats porridge, to make it more healthy and tastier I added some apples in it. I added some clean cinnamon powder which I bought during my last visit to Chennai in nuts & spices shop. To my surprise she loved it. Cinnamon not only gives a lovely aroma to the porridge, but it also helps indigestion.

 

Things to remember:

1) I used instant oats since that is the only oats available in my place. If you can get steel-cut oats, then they are highly recommended.

2) You could add any fruits in this porridge that your baby loves.

3) Adding cinnamon is optional. You can leave it or simply add any other spices like cardamom,

4) If you are afraid, whether oats/oatmeal cause constipation in babies. In my opinion and experience, oats/oatmeal won't cause constipation.

5) Puree the oats porridge finely or to the texture, you like to feed your baby.

6) If your apples are too sweet and you find your porridge to be sweet enough. Then don't add any sugar. 

7) I am not feeding oats daily to maha. I give ragi porridge one day, the next day I feed raw banana powder porridge(recipe soon), then the next day I give her oats porridge. So she doesn’t feel bored with the same food. 

8) I recommend you to start oatmeal on the 6th month of your baby.

 

How to make porridge:

 

Ingredients:

 

Oats – 1.5 tablespoon

Apple – 1/2 a big apple

Cinnamon Powder – 1/4 tsp

Water – 1/2 cup or adjust

 

Method:

 

Start by peeling and chopping 1/2 an apple into small pieces.

Take a clean saucepan, in which you cook your baby's food. Add oats, chopped apple, cinnamon and clean water in it.

Put the saucepan on the stove and cook it for 3 to 4 mins on a low flame till the oats are completely cooked.

Now take it off the stove and let it cool a bit. Pour the whole mix in a blender and make it into a smooth puree. 

Pour the porridge on to clean sterilized bowls and feed your baby. You

can pour this into a feeding bottle and feed your baby. I cut a bigger

hole in my feeding bottle nipple and feed my baby, this way it is easy

and convenient.

blogs.title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes ( Using Milk ) Recipes for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए मलाईदार मसला हुआ आलू (दूध का उपयोग करके) व्यंजन
blogs.content:
These foods help in healthy weight gaining on babies. I didn’t start rice yet, because as per our custom we will take that as a big function and feed the first rice to maha in front of God in a temple.

The other foods which are rich in carbohydrates are potatoes and sweet potatoes. Potatoes are really good for your babies. They have few vitamins in them but they are mainly rich in carbohydrates and starch. I added some formula milk in this mash to make it more creamy, but you could simply leave it out and add warm water. But never add cow’s milk until your baby is 1 year old. This is what my pediatrician told me.

You can even add carrots in this and make it as a double veggie mash. Carrots give a lovely sweetness to the mash and it will be a different food for your baby.

I get so many emails from my viewers about formula milk and breast milk. Here is an article about Toddler Formula vs Milk. I hope it will be helpful for you.

 

Things to remember:

 

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth. 

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion & experience potatoes won't cause any constipation in babies. But it may cause gas in some babies. Anyhow, I won't feed this puree daily, I give it two times a week.

4) I don't prefer freezing potato purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge.

5) When choosing potatoes, get firm, white variety.

6) Potato is less likely to have any allergenic reactions.

 

Tips from Viewer Comment:

 

You may add 3-4 jeera while boiling the potatoes. You may either grind it and feed the baby or else take it off before feeding as the essence would be taken in it. this helps the baby from getting any gas problems.

 

How to make Potato Puree:

 

Ingredients:

 

Potato – 1 medium size ( fresh and white variety)

Formula Milk Powder – 1 scoop ( I use lactogen )

Water – 3 to 4 tablespoon + for boiling potatoes

 

Method:

 

Take a firm, fresh, white potato. Peel it and cube them. Wash it well in cold water.

Add it to a saucepan, cover it with clean water. Put it on the stove and bring it to boil.

Simmer the flame and cook till the potatoes are tender. This will take around 15 mins.

Now drain it and put it in a bowl. Mash it up.

Now to make the puree creamy, make some formula milk. Dissolve some formula milk powder which you are using for your baby in some warm water. Pour this over the mashed potato and mash it more to make it creamy.

Transfer this to a bowl and feed your baby with a spoon.

blogs.title: Raw Banana Porridge ( Weight Gaining ) Recipes for Babies
blogs.title_hi: कच्चे केले का दलिया (वजन प्राप्त करना) शिशुओं के लिए व्यंजन विधि
blogs.content:
As soon as I mentioned that I will post a banana powder recipe for babies, I got so many emails asking to post them immediately. But it was difficult to find time to post it, finally, I managed to get banana powder recipe and banana porridge recipe up at the same time.

This powder is so healthy, it helps in healthy weight gaining in your babies. Normally we feed ragi porridge for babies, and I am sure that babies will get bored because of the same food. So in order to make their food interesting and different, you can follow what I normally do.

 

Few things you have to remember before making this.

 

1) The consistency of the porridge which you make totally depends on you. You can make it too runnier and pour it bottles and feed your baby or make it a little thicker and feed your baby using a spoon.

2) I use panakarkandu or karupatti as sweetener. Karupatti strengthens your baby bones. Panakarkandu helps to prevent cold for your babies. You can even mix up a small piece of both.

3) If you feed a good bowl of this for your baby. Your baby will sleep peacefully for a good 2 to 3 hours. It is that filling.

4) This won't cause constipation in babies.

 

How to make Raw Banana Porridge:

 

Take a clean saucepan, add in 2 tablespoons of karupatti. Now pour in 3/4 cup of clean water. Heat this up and cook until the karupatti is melted.

Now take a clean bowl and add 2 scoops of banana powder. Add some clean water and mix it up till smooth. 

Now place a fine-mesh strainer over the bowl and Sieve the karupatti liquid through this. Mix this well.

I washed the saucepan in the meantime. Now pour this liquid again in the saucepan.

Heat this on a low flame stirring continuously. Cook this for around 2 mins till the banana is cooked and thicken.

Take it off the heat, allow it to cool down and transfer it to a feeding bowl or feeding bottle and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Carrot and Potato Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए गाजर और आलू प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
I have been sharing veg and fruit purees, porridges, health powders for babies till now.

Now coming to today’s recipe. Potatoes are usually bland by their nature. So I love to add other sweet veggies to it to make it tastier for babies. Normally I add some sweet carrots to it, I even add a piece of beetroots too. Potatoes make this puree more creamy and carrots add a natural sweetness to this puree too.

 

Things to remember:

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.  

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion & experience potatoes won't cause any constipation in babies. But it may cause gas in some babies. Anyhow, I won't feed this puree daily, I give it two times a week.

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge.

5) When choosing potatoes, get firm, white variety.

6) Potato and carrots are less likely to have any allergenic reactions.

 

How to make Carrot & Potato Puree:

 

Choose a fresh, firm potato and carrot. Wash them well. Peel them slightly. Cube them. Put them in water and wash them well till there is no starch. 

Now transfer them in a saucepan, cover them with clean water. 

Place it on the stove and bring it to boil. Cover it and simmer it. Cook for 12 to 15 mins till the veggies are completely cooked. 

Now drain the veggies to a bowl or a mixer. Reserve the cooking liquid. 

You can puree them in a blender or use a hand-blender. Use the reserved liquid to thin the puree if needed. 

Transfer this to a bowl and feed your baby with a spoon.

blogs.title: Barley Apple Porridge ( Cereal ) Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए जौ सेब दलिया (अनाज) पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Barley makes the best first food for babies. Since it is less allergenic and it is quite filling too. I made an easy porridge using that and added some apples into it to make it a little sweeter. I used the whole barley, so I used a pressure cooker to cook it. I have included a method for cooking barley on a saucepan too. So make sure you read the complete recipe.

 

Few things you have to remember before making this.

 

1) The consistency of the porridge which you make totally depends on you. You can make it too runnier and pour it bottles and feed your baby or make it a little thicker and feed your baby using a spoon.

2) If you feed a good bowl of this for your baby. Your baby will sleep peacefully for a good 2 hours. It is that filling.

3) This won't cause constipation in babies. I am feeding this every alternate day to maha and she is passing stool daily.  

4) You can start feeding this to a 6 to a 10-month baby.

 

How to make Barley Apple Porridge for Babies:

 

Ingredients:

 

Whole Barley – 1/4 cup

Apples – 1 cup peeled and cubed

Water – 3.5 cup

 

Method:

 

First, start by cooking barley. Take barley in a bowl and wash it well. Add it to a pressure cooker, pour over 3 cups of water, cover and pressure cook for 5 whistles. simmer for 15 to 20 mins. Switch off the heat and let the pressure go all by itself. Open the pressure cooker, taste to see whether the apples are cooked.

Now add in the chopped apples and 1/2 cup of water.

Place it on the stove and cook on a low heat for 2 mins.

Now puree this using a hand blender or using a blender till it is smooth.

Pour into a clean bowl and feed your baby.

How to cook barley on the stovetop:

Take whole barley in a blender and powder it.

Heat 3 cups of water in a saucepan, Bring it to a good boil.

Add in barley powder and keep whisking. Now cover it and simmer the pan for 25 to 30 mins till it is completely cooked and the porridge gets thick.

Now add in pureed apples and cook for a further 2 mins.

You can serve this porridge to babies as it is, or if you want it super smooth, you can puree this once more and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Apple, Pear and Cinnamon Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए सेब, नाशपाती और दालचीनी प्यूरी पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Apples and Pears make a portion of great baby food. I give apple puree one day, pear puree(recipe soon) the next day. Then I mix them up and feed her. I also add a dash of cinnamon to spice it up. Check out my detail post about spicing baby foods.

 

Things to remember:

 

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion and experience, pears and apple won't cause any constipation in babies.

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge.

5) Apple and pear are less likely to have any allergenic reactions.

 

How to make Apple, Pear & Cinnamon Puree:

 

Take half an apple and half a pear. Peel them and cube them.

Add it to a saucepan, add in half to one cup of water. Add a dash of cinnamon.

Put it on the stove and bring it to a boil, cover and simmer the pan. Cook on a low heat for 5 to 8 mins.

Now take them in a blender and puree them.

Pour into a clean bowl and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Steamed Mashed Banana ( Nendrapazham )  Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: स्टीम्ड मसला हुआ केला ( नेंद्रापझम ) प्यूरी रेसिपी फॉर बेबीज़
blogs.content:
Bananas are high in potassium. In our place, we get a type of banana called as “matti pazham“. It will small in size and smells so sweet. We mash them up and feed babies. You don't have to steam them. It is really good for babies. But I have heard that you cannot find it in many places. But I am sure that nendran pazham is easily available in all places. And it makes great baby food. But I prefer to steam it and feed baby, so it is easily digestible. Plus it is a great food for weight gaining in babies.

  

Things to remember:

 

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by. 

3) In my opinion & experience banana won't cause any constipation in babies. I feed this banana puree thrice a week.

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day.

5) Ripe Bananas are less likely to have any allergenic reactions. 

6) Use ripe banana for this, it will taste good and is easily digestible. 

 

How to make Steamed Mashed Banana:

 

Take a ripe banana (nendrapazham). It has to be fresh and ripe. Cut it in half and place it on a steamer plate.

Place the plate on the steamer and cover it. Steam for a good 10 to 12 mins.

Pierce with a knife to see whether it is cooked. If you go in easily then it is cooked.

Peel the skin off and cut it into small pieces.

Put them in a blender and puree them. You can add some clean water to adjust the consistency.

Pour this into sterilized clean bowls and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Health Powder Mix (Wheat, Moong Dal, and Almond ) Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: स्वास्थ्य पाउडर मिक्स (गेहूं, मूंग दाल, और बादाम) बच्चों के लिए पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
This makes a great filling and protein-rich food for your babies because it has wheat and moong dal in it. And the addition of almonds makes it super healthy. I used wheat powder in this recipe, my mom buys whole wheat, wash it, dry it in sun and grind it in the mill, I used that homemade powder for this recipe. If you can find good wheat powder you can use that. Or get whole wheat and do what my mom did.

 

Things to remember before making this powder:

 

1) Make sure you roast all the stuff really well before grinding it. 

2) Always make small batches, so the powder stays fresh always.  

3) You can store the powder in an airtight container in the fridge too. I always store homemade powders in the fridge. 

4) This porridge can be given for babies who are above 6 months.   

5) This wheat powder doesn’t cause constipation in babies. 

6) The consistency of the porridge which you make totally depends on you. You can make it too runnier and pour it bottles and feed your baby or make it a little thicker and feed your baby using a spoon. 

7) I use panakarkandu or karupatti as a sweetener. Karupatti strengthens your baby bones. Panakarkandu helps to prevent cold for your babies. You can even mix up a small piece of both. 

8) If you feed a good bowl of this for your baby. Your baby will sleep peacefully for a good 2 to 3 hours. It is that filling. 

9) Instead of Almonds, you can use cashews too or a mixture of both.

 

How to introduce solid food to your baby:

How to make Wheat, Moongdal & Almond Porridge:

 

Ingredients:

 

Whole Wheat flour – 1 cup

Yellow Split Moong Dal / Pasi Paruppu – 1/2 cup

Almonds / Badam – 1/4 cup

 

Method:

 

Wash moong dal well in lots of water, let it drain in a sieve for 10 to 15 mins.

Heat a heavy bottom Kadai. Add moong dal in it and roast it on medium heat. The moisture will evaporate and the dal will get golden. It will take around 10 to 15 mins. Once it reaches that stage removes to a plate.

Now in the same Kadai roast almonds till they turn golden. It will take around 5 mins. Remove that to the same plate as well.

Now in the same Kadai add in whole wheat flour and roast them on very low heat till nice aroma comes from it. It will take around 5 mins.

Now take the moong dal and almonds in a blender and make it into a smooth powder. Add that powder to the wheat flour and mix well.

Spread them on a plate to cool down. You can see them also.

Store this in an airtight container in the fridge.

For Making Porridge out of this powder, Check this.

blogs.title: Potato, Carrot and Beetroot Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए आलू, गाजर और चुकंदर प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
I have already share carrots and potato puree in my blog already. For a variation, I added some beetroots in the puree as well. So it is more healthy and nutritious. Beetroots have not only the amazing color, but it is also rich in antioxidants, folate, manganese, potassium, vitamin -A and many other properties. So it is good for your babies.

Now drain the veggies to a bowl or a mixer. Reserve the cooking liquid. 

You can puree them in a blender or use a hand-blender. Use the reserved liquid to thin the puree if needed. 

Transfer this to a bowl and feed your baby with a spoon.

blogs.title: Pomegranate Juice Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए अनार का जूस रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Summer is here. It is absolutely crucial to feed as much liquid food to your baby either as water or in the form of juices. There are certain fruits which you should avoid for babies and certain fruits can be given for them. This series gives an idea about what fruit juice you can feed your baby and the best way to juice it. I hope it will help you.

 

I am starting with the most health packed fruit which is pomegranate, It cures digestive problems in babies, intestinal worms control fevers and has lots of liver protection problems. You can refer more to their properties here.

 

Things to remember before feeding baby:

 

1) No seeds of this should be given for babies. Only juice must be fed. 

2) Make sure you don't grind the white skin of the pomegranate. Remove all of them and grind only the seeds of pomegranate so the juice will be sweet.

3) If your juice is not that sweet, you can add some sweetener to it.

4) Don't feed this at night, morning and afternoon is a good time to feed juice for baby.

5) This won't cause gas problems or constipation in babies.

 

How to introduce solid food to your baby:

 

How to make Pomegranate Juice:

Take a firm fresh pomegranate. Make sure the pomegranate seeds are not sour, it should be sweet.

Cut them open. Take a wooden spoon or a ladle. Use the back of it bashes the pomegranate to get all the seeds out.

Now take the seeds alone in a blender and puree them.

Place a strainer over a bowl. Pour the puree over it and press with a spoon to get as much juice as possible.

Now pour the juice in a sipper or feeding bottle and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Pear ( Sauce ) Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए नाशपाती (सॉस) प्यूरी पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Pears make great baby food. I give apple puree one day, pear puree the next day and I mix them and make apple pear puree and feed her. I also add a dash of cinnamon to spice it up. Check out my detail post about spicing baby foods. Pear makes great first food for babies since it is less allergenic and it easily digests. Your baby will love it for sure.

 

Things to remember:

 

1) The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.

2) Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3) In my opinion and experience, pears won't cause any constipation in babies.

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. But if you are busy or find difficult to get time, then freeze it in individual containers and thaw it overnight in the fridge. 

 

How to make Pear Puree:

 

Take a firm fresh and sweet pear. Wash them well.

Peel them, decore them and cube them. 

Place it in a bowl and place that over a saucepan with water, Put it on the stove and bring it to a boil, cover and simmer the pan. Cook on a low heat for 10 to 12 mins.

You can steam them as you wish. 

Now take them in a blender and puree them. 

Pour into a clean bowl and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Sooji ( Rava ) Kheer Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए सूजी (रवा) खीर रेसिपी
blogs.content:
When your baby gets bored to the usual ragi porridge, raw banana porridge, and wheat porridge, then this sooji porridge comes as a lifesaver. It is so easy to prepare and so healthy for babies too. There are certain things you have to read must before making this.

 

Things to remember before making this:

 

1) Roast sooji well in the ghee this makes it easy to digest in babies.

2) You can roast sooji in bulk and store it in an airtight container in the fridge and use it accordingly.

3) If you want a finer and smooth kheer, powder the roasted sooji in a blender, this will make smoother kheer and your baby will find it easy to swallow. I make it that way only. The texture depends upon your baby's interest. 

4) For babies above 1-year-old, you can make this kheer with cow’s milk, for babies below 1-year cow’s milk is not advisable.

5) Don't add formula milk to hot kheer since formula milk should not be cooked, let the kheer comes to a warm temp in which you feed your baby, then add the prepared formula milk.

6) I use panakarkandu or karupatti as a sweetener. Karupatti strengthens your baby bones. Panakarkandu helps to prevent cold for your babies. You can even mix up a small piece of both.

7) If you feed a good bowl of this for your baby. Your baby will sleep peacefully for a good 2 to 3 hours. It is that filling.

8) Sooji doesn’t cause constipation in babies.

9) Sooji is easy to digest and non-allergenic food.

10)The consistency of the porridge which you make totally depends on you. You can make it too runnier and pour it bottles and feed your baby or make it a little thicker and feed your baby using a spoon.

 

How to make Sooji Kheer for Babies & Infants :

 

Ingredients: 

 

Sooji / Semolina / Suji / Rava – 2 tablespoon

Jaggery /Sarkarai / Vellam / Palmsugar – 2 tablespoon

Clean Water – 1 cup

Ghee – 1 tsp

Formula Milk – 1/4 cup (Use cow’s milk for babies above 1 year)

                           (I use lactogen for my baby) 

 

Method:

 

Take a clean saucepan and add in a tsp of ghee. Add in sooji and roast it on a low flame till it turns light golden. Now remove that to a bowl. 

In the same saucepan add in jaggery and some water. Heat it till jaggery melts. Now strain this mix and pour it into a saucepan.

Add in roasted sooji and mix well. Cook till the sooji is well cooked, it will take around 10 mins.

Now remove the saucepan from heat and let it cool a bit. Meanwhile, make formula milk. Pour this milk to the warm sooji kheer and mix well.

Pour into sterilized bowls and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Moong Dal Khichdi Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए मूंग दाल खिचड़ी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
As you all know rice is rich in carbohydrates and it gives the energy which your baby needs and helps in healthy weight gain. Adding dal into rice makes it more wholesome and provides the protein which your baby needs.

 

Things to remember before making this

1) Cook rice and dal properly till it is almost mashed up, which helps in easy digestion in babies.

2) Always wash rice and dal very well to remove all the starch and wacky stuff from it.

3) Add garlic, cumin and asafoetida help in digestion in babies.

4) This khichdi is so filling and nutritious meal for your babies.

5) You can start feeding this for babies above 6 months.

6) Always feed this meal for lunch, not for dinner.

7) The consistency of this is up to you. You can mash them with a potato masher, or put them in a blender and make into a fine puree. I make it into a fine puree.

8) Adding ghee enhances the flavor and makes it more nutritious for your baby and helps in weight gaining in babies.

9) Make sure the ghee which you use is pure ones. I make my own ghee.

10) Rice won't cause constipation, allergies in babies. 

 

How to make Rice & Dal Khichdi:

Ingredients:

 

Rice – 3 tablespoon

Yellow Moong Dal / Pasi Paruppu – 3 tablespoon

Garlic – 2 fat cloves

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam – 1/2 tsp

Asafoetida / Hing / Kaya Podi – a pinch

Turmeric Powder / Manjal Podi – 1/4 tsp 

Salt to taste

Homemade Ghee – 1 tablespoon

Water – 1 1/2 cup

 

 

Method:

 

Take rice and dal in a bowl and wash it well. Now drain it and add it into a pressure cooker.

Add in garlic, cumin seeds, asafoetida, salt, turmeric powder, and asafoetida.

Add in water and cover the cooker. Pressure cook this for 5 whistles and simmer it for 5 mins. Switch off the flame and let the steam escape all by itself.

Open the cooker and mash the rice with a potato masher or if you want it to be smooth, you can take that in a blender and puree them.

Pour this into a bowl. Drizzle in homemade ghee and mix well.

Feed your baby warm.

blogs.title: Spinach Khichdi ( Rice, Dal ) Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: पालक खिचड़ी (चावल, दाल) बच्चों के लिए रेसिपी
blogs.content:

How to make Rice & Dal Khichdi:

 

Ingredients:

blogs.title: Homemade Health Mix Powder ( Sathu Maavu Mix ) Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: घर का बना स्वास्थ्य मिश्रण पाउडर (सत्तू मावू मिक्स) बच्चों के लिए पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
This is a super-duper healthy mix for your baby. You could buy a decent health powder mix from shops. But I love to make it myself for my baby because you get to know what goes into them and you can customize it as per your baby needs. 

I added rice and pulses in my health mix. So I feed this porridge for my baby for lunch instead of giving rice khichdi. I made two versions of this powder, one savory and one sweet. 

 

For making porridge out of it:

 

you can mix a couple of tablespoons of this powder with some water and cook it for 10 mins on a very low flame till the rice and dal are cooked. Then you can add some sweetener to sweet one and salt in the savory one. It is that simple.

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time: 1 hour

 

Ingredients:

 

Rice – 1.5 cup ( I used cooking rice, ponni brand)

Barley – 1 cup

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai / Pottu Kadalai – 1 cup

Whole Black Urad Dal – 1 cup

Green Gram Dal – 1 cup

Yellow Moong Dal / Pasi Paruppu – 1/2 cup

Masoor Dal – 1/2 cup

Broken Wheat / Cracked Wheat / Dalia – 1 cup

Cashew – 1/2 cup

Badam / Almond – 1/2 cup

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam – 1 teaspoon

Ajwain Seeds / Omam – 1/2 teaspoon

Cardamom / Yelakai – 10 pods (If using this, leave ajwain and cumin)

 

 

Method:

 

Take urad dal and green gram in a bowl and wash them well, drain and add to a dry pan and roast till it turns golden brown and dry. Remove to a plate.

Take masoor dal and yellow moong dal in a bowl and wash them well, drain and add to a

dry pan and roast till it turns golden brown and dry. Remove to the same plate.

Take rice and barley in a bowl and wash them well, drain and add to a

dry pan and roast till it turns golden brown and dry. Remove to the same

plate.

Roast roasted gram dal till golden and remove to the same plate.

Roast Dalia till golden and remove to the same plate.

Roast cashews and almonds till golden and remove to the same plate.

Roast cumin and ajwain till golden and remove to the same plate. If you are making a sweet one, leave ajwain and cumin and add cardamom to it.

I made two versions, so I took half of the mix and added cardamom to one and roasted cumin and ajwain in another. Now grind them in a mixer and sieve it.

Store in an airtight container.

blogs.title: Ghee Rice and Boiled Egg Yolk Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए घी चावल और उबले अंडे की जर्दी की रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Its been a while since I shared baby food recipes in this blog. It's all because of laziness. I have a few baby recipes to share, so I decided to post all of them now, so many will get benefited from that. 

 

To add more taste to rice, I add a touch of rice and some freshly ground pepper in it. Maha loves it a lot.

 

1) Cook rice properly till it is almost mashed up, which helps in easy digestion in babies. 

2) Always wash rice very well to remove all the starch and wacky stuff from it. 

3) Add garlic and asafoetida when cooking rice if you wish This helps in digestion in babies. 

4) This is so filling and nutritious meal for your babies. 

5) You can start feeding this for babies above 6 months. For 6 month baby don't add pepper.

6) Always feed this meal for lunch, not for dinner. 

7) The consistency of this is up to you. You can mash them with a potato masher, or put them in a blender and make into a fine puree. I make it into a fine puree. 

8) Adding ghee enhances the flavor and makes it more nutritious for your baby and helps in weight gaining in babies. 

9) Make sure the ghee which you use is pure ones. I make my own ghee. 

10) Rice won't cause constipation, allergies in babies.

  

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

   

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use.

 

How to make ghee rice for babies:

 

Ingredients:

 

Rice – 1/2 cup cooked

Ghee – 1 teaspoon

Salt a pinch

Freshly Ground Pepper a pinch

 

Method:

Take cooked rice in a bowl, mash it well.

Add a spoon of ghee, salt, and pepper and mix well. Mash it well again.

Serve it with egg yolk.
